@section l35-02 | Unit 2 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 2 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The company's salary s______e is based on employees' work experience and length of employment.
= structure
~詞義 structure（n.）結構
~原文 The company's salary structure is based on employees' work experience and length of employment.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Our P.E. teacher always asks us to o______e his movements closely before we start playing basketball.
= observe
~詞義 observe（v.）觀察
~原文 Our P.E. teacher always asks us to observe his movements closely before we start playing basketball.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: More workers had to be hired because the factory needed to p______e a large quantity of goods.
= produce
~詞義 produce（v.）生產
~原文 More workers had to be hired because the factory needed to produce a large quantity of goods.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The policeman's success in tracking and arresting the brutal murderer was ______ (admire).
= admirable
~詞義 admirable（adj.）可欽佩的
~原文 The policeman's success in tracking and arresting the brutal murderer was admirable.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The expert explained why it is often highly ______ (profit) to invest in real estate.
= profitable
~詞義 profitable（adj.）有利潤的
~原文 The expert explained why it is often highly profitable to invest in real estate.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: My ______ for Jake is beyond description; he devotes himself full-time to helping the poor.
A: preparation
B: imagination
C: determination
D: admiration
= D
~詞義 admiration（n.）欽佩
~原文 My admiration for Jake is beyond description; he devotes himself full-time to helping the poor.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Andy tried to ______ his parents into letting him study abroad for one semester.
A: persuade
B: detect
C: shorten
D: recognize
= A
~詞義 persuade（v.）說服
~原文 Andy tried to persuade his parents into letting him study abroad for one semester.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher ______ of the students' careless attitude toward their group project.
A: reduced
B: determined
C: appealed
D: disapproved
= D
~詞義 disapprove（v.）不贊成
~原文 The teacher disapproved of the students' careless attitude toward their group project.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The candidate left a good ______ on the public by listening to everyone's concerns carefully.
A: reduction
B: promotion
C: observation
D: impression
= D
~詞義 impression（n.）印象
~原文 The candidate left a good impression on the public by listening to everyone's concerns carefully.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Selina ______ on stage, forgetting every word of her speech while the audience just stared at her in silence.
A: froze
B: attracted
C: secured
D: reserved
= A
~詞義 freeze（v.）僵住
~原文 Selina froze on stage, forgetting every word of her speech while the audience just stared at her in silence.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: attractive
B: imaginative
C: reduction
D: prevent
E: effective
F: persuasion

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: It took Nancy lots of ______ to convince her brother to change his mind.
= F
~詞義 persuasion（n.）說服
~原文 It took Nancy lots of persuasion to convince her brother to change his mind.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Karl feels disappointed that his back injury may ______ him from playing in tomorrow's game.
= D
~詞義 prevent（v.）阻止
~原文 Karl feels disappointed that his back injury may prevent him from playing in tomorrow's game.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Students are encouraged to write ______ works in the creative writing class.
= B
~詞義 imaginative（adj.）富有想像力的
~原文 Students are encouraged to write imaginative works in the creative writing class.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company needs to make its advertisements ______ to a wider range of people.
= A
~詞義 attractive（adj.）吸引人的
~原文 The company needs to make its advertisements attractive to a wider range of people.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: With the appearance of smartphones, a large ______ in sales of MP3 players was seen.
= C
~詞義 reduction（n.）減少
~原文 With the appearance of smartphones, a large reduction in sales of MP3 players was seen.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: vision
B: advice
C: efficient
D: detective
E: invisible
F: reduce

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: It would be smart to seek ______ from a qualified expert before you make such an important decision.
= B
~詞義 advice（n.）建議
~原文 It would be smart to seek advice from a qualified expert before you make such an important decision.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Great leaders often possess a clear ______ that guides their decisions and motivates others.
= A
~詞義 vision（n.）遠見
~原文 Great leaders often possess a clear vision that guides their decisions and motivates others.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. Woods is a(n) ______; his job is to discover information about crimes and find out who committed them.
= D
~詞義 detective（n.）偵探
~原文 Mr. Woods is a(n) detective; his job is to discover information about crimes and find out who committed them.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Taking public transportation regularly is a good way to ______ air pollution.
= F
~詞義 reduce（v.）減少
~原文 Taking public transportation regularly is a good way to reduce air pollution.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company is seeking a more ______ way to deliver its products to the customers.
= C
~詞義 efficient（adj.）有效率的
~原文 The company is seeking a more efficient way to deliver its products to the customers.
